proposals.relationship: Deloria criticized the culturally biased social-scientific approach of the workshops McNickle organized, as David Beck’s 1995 history reports.
proposals.evidence_note: Program-level criticism, not rejection of all McNickle’s writing. Beck identifies Deloria as a guest speaker at the 1965 workshop and one of its critics, citing Dorothy Parker (1992), p. 195; that book and Deloria’s original statement remain unread. Douglas Miller’s 2016 review separately describes a widening ideological gulf, while challenging a dismissive account of McNickle. Neither source establishes McNickle as Deloria’s mentor.
primary_locators: Beck (1995), printed p. 22, right column final paragraph, and p. 24 note 34; PDF pages 8 and 10.
Miller (2016), pp. 169–170: generational gulf and qualified criticism of the later biography’s treatment of McNickle.
